scope: Implement a cross-platform local agent/enrollment skeleton with explicit node identity, authenticated versioned capability envelopes, replay rejection, lifecycle state, and allowlisted host-control operations only; do not expose a remote listener before authenticated encrypted transport exists.
completion_condition: Enrollment identity/capability envelope/lifecycle code, bounded replay-safe verification tests, docs/ADR/validation and CI are committed.
next_step: Implement mutually authenticated encrypted private transport around the enrolled agent, keeping legacy/native workers loopback-only and preserving bounded message/replay semantics.
instructions: Completed without opening a remote listener. Enrollment secrets are runtime-only and never serialized. Host agents reserve only their own node's physical pools. This does not claim secure LAN transport, CUDA/HIP qualification, Windows GPU execution, performance or distributed inference.
